Parking the roadmap: Stage 1 is complete and Stage 2 (closure notices) goes to the deferred backlog.

**What parking does (derive-roadmap §5):**
1. **Stage 2 becomes one deferred item.** It goes in `specs/deferred_items.md` under a new section `## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06`. The item will be self-contained, with a `Size:` field, and its `Done when:` will name Stage 2's Produces: the notice job and its operator mailing list. It must follow the Deferred-item schema, which I haven't read yet, so I'll read that first.
2. **The roadmap moves to `specs/completed/`.** It will be marked `PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete`.
3. **No other input files retire with it.** This roadmap came from your own words on 2026-10-14, not from a synthesized spec. There is no methodology or critique file.
4. **The Stage 1 findings and plan 4 stay where they are.** They are finished work.

**Calls, in order:**

```
Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/references/deferred-backlog.md   # Deferred-item schema
Read specs/deferred_items.md                                          # may not exist; create if not
Edit specs/deferred_items.md      # append the dated section with the Stage 2 item
Edit specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md   # add under the title:
                                      # > PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete. Canal study funding ended; Stage 2 deferred to specs/deferred_items.md.
Bash: mkdir -p specs/completed && git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
Bash: git add specs/deferred_items.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md && git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended, 1 of 2 stages complete"
```

The commit is local, on `main`. I won't push.

**One gap in the parking rule:** Track A's Ranked list (O2 outlook, O3 per-lock curves, O4 map) holds outcomes that never became stages. The rule only moves unticked stages to the backlog. Unless you say otherwise, those three stay recorded only in the parked roadmap, where they won't age or come up for review. If you want them in the backlog too, say so and I'll add them as three more deferred items in the same section.
